# Technical Typography Showcase

High-performance technical presentations with unified typography.

## Architecture & Code Demonstration

This slide demonstrates customized font rendering across paragraph text and code blocks.

- Heading and body text rendered using \`BIZ UDPGothic\`
- Code blocks and inline code styled with \`Cascadia Code\`
- Fully editable shapes and text runs preserved in PowerPoint output

